Comments: The value of the activity’s budget for each financial quarter or year over its lifetime.

Use transaction type “1 - Incoming funds” for received funds, or transaction type “11 - Incoming commitment” for future agreed incoming funds.


Use the field “provider activity id” to reference your funder's activity and link your data to their's.

Use transaction type “3 - Disbursement” for funds paid to other organisations, or transaction type “2 - Outgoing commitment” for future agreed payments.

If your organisation hasn't made any outgoing fund transactions yet, you can publish your activity and add them later.

Use transaction type “4 - Expenditure” for funds spent on goods or services for the activity.

These can be aggregated into one expenditure transaction per quarter.
Planned disbursements allow you to publish predefined payment schedules. They should be reported for a specific date or period, and should not replace the activity’s budget.
